name: Yamaha YZ125
engine: 124 cc two-stroke single, air-cooled then liquid-cooled, carb, premix
intro: Yamaha's long-running 125 two-stroke. Premix, a power valve on later years and a top end that needs regular rebuilds.

B: It runs on premix. Mix the oil into the fuel at the ratio in the manual.

recallNote: Off-road models are not always in the NHTSA recall search. Ask a Yamaha dealer to run the VIN as well.
